```{ojs}
consTarget = 0

consParametersAt = (scenario, n) => {
  if (scenario === "Asymptotically unbiased only") {
    return {mean: 2 / Math.sqrt(n), sd: 0.8};
  }
  if (scenario === "Unbiased but not consistent") {
    return {mean: 0, sd: 0.8};
  }
  return {mean: 1 / Math.sqrt(n), sd: 1 / Math.sqrt(n)};
}

consErf = value => {
  const sign = value < 0 ? -1 : 1;
  const x = Math.abs(value);
  const t = 1 / (1 + 0.3275911 * x);
  const polynomial = (((((1.061405429 * t - 1.453152027) * t) +
    1.421413741) * t - 0.284496736) * t + 0.254829592) * t;
  return sign * (1 - polynomial * Math.exp(-x * x));
}

consNormalCdf = value => 0.5 * (1 + consErf(value / Math.sqrt(2)))

consOutsideProbability = (scenario, n, epsilon) => {
  const parameters = consParametersAt(scenario, n);
  const lowerZ = (consTarget - epsilon - parameters.mean) / parameters.sd;
  const upperZ = (consTarget + epsilon - parameters.mean) / parameters.sd;
  return consNormalCdf(lowerZ) + 1 - consNormalCdf(upperZ);
}

consParameters = consParametersAt(consControls.scenario, consControls.n)
consProbabilityOutside = consOutsideProbability(
  consControls.scenario,
  consControls.n,
  consControls.epsilon
)

consDensityDomain = [-3, 5]
consDensity = d3.range(321).map(index => {
  const x = consDensityDomain[0] + index *
    (consDensityDomain[1] - consDensityDomain[0]) / 320;
  const y = Math.exp(-0.5 * ((x - consParameters.mean) / consParameters.sd) ** 2) /
    (consParameters.sd * Math.sqrt(2 * Math.PI));
  return {x, y};
})

consDensityYMax = Math.max(0.52, d3.max(consDensity, point => point.y) * 1.12)

consProbabilityPath = d3.range(1, 101).map(n => ({
  n,
  probability: consOutsideProbability(
    consControls.scenario,
    n,
    consControls.epsilon
  )
}))
```

```{ojs}
consDensityPlot = Plot.plot({

  y: {label: "Density", domain: [0, consDensityYMax], grid: true},
  marks: [
    Plot.rect([{
      x1: consTarget - consControls.epsilon,
      x2: consTarget + consControls.epsilon,
      y1: 0,
      y2: consDensityYMax
    }], {
      x1: "x1",
      x2: "x2",
      y1: "y1",
      y2: "y2",

    Plot.text([{x: consTarget, y: consDensityYMax * 0.94}], {

consProbabilityPlot = Plot.plot({
```

```{ojs}
consConclusion = consControls.scenario === "Consistent (biased at finite n)"
  ? html`The centre approaches ${tex`\theta`}, the spread shrinks, and the outside probability tends to zero: this sequence is <strong>consistent</strong>.`
  : consControls.scenario === "Asymptotically unbiased only"
    ? html`The centre approaches ${tex`\theta`}, but the spread remains. The outside probability does not tend to zero: asymptotic unbiasedness alone is <strong>not consistency</strong>.`
    : html`The estimator is centred exactly on ${tex`\theta`} for every ${tex`n`}, but its spread remains. Unbiasedness alone is <strong>not consistency</strong>.`

consReadout = md`${tex`\mathrm E[\hat\theta_n]=${consParameters.mean.toFixed(3)};\quad
  \operatorname{sd}(\hat\theta_n)=${consParameters.sd.toFixed(3)};\quad
  \Pr\!\left(\lvert\hat\theta_n-\theta\rvert>\varepsilon\right)=${consProbabilityOutside.toFixed(3)}`}`

html`<div class="cons-figure-shell">
  <div class="cons-plots">
    <div class="cons-plot-panel">
      <strong>Sampling distribution and the ${tex`\varepsilon`}-band</strong>
      ${consDensityPlot}
    </div>
    <div class="cons-plot-panel">
      <strong>Probability of missing the band</strong>
      ${consProbabilityPlot}
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="cons-legend" aria-label="Plot legend">
    <span><i class="cons-band"></i> ${tex`\theta\pm\varepsilon`} tolerance band</span>
    <span><i class="cons-density"></i> Sampling distribution of ${tex`\hat\theta_n`}</span>
    <span><i class="cons-centre"></i> Centre ${tex`\mathrm E[\hat\theta_n]`}</span>
  </div>
  <div class="cons-readout" role="status" aria-live="polite">
    ${consReadout}
  </div>
</div>

<style>
```

```{ojs}
// Keep the control view in its own output cell below the reactive figure.
// Embedding it in the figure template would replace a slider during a drag.
viewof consControls = {
  const sequenceForm = Inputs.form({
    scenario: Inputs.select([
      "Consistent (biased at finite n)",
      "Asymptotically unbiased only",
      "Unbiased but not consistent"
    ], {
      value: "Consistent (biased at finite n)",
      label: "Estimator sequence"
    })
  }, {submit: false});

  const toleranceForm = Inputs.form({
    n: Inputs.range([1, 100], {
      value: 1,
      step: 1,
      label: md`Sample size ${tex`n`}`
    }),
    epsilon: Inputs.range([0.2, 1.2], {
      value: 0.5,
      step: 0.1,
      label: md`Tolerance ${tex`\varepsilon`}`
    })
  }, {submit: false});

  const root = html`<div class="controls-wrap">
    <details class="controls-root" open>
      <summary>Simulation controls</summary>
      <div class="controls-grid">
        <div class="controls-col"><h4>Estimator sequence</h4></div>
        <div class="controls-col"><h4>Sample size &amp; tolerance</h4></div>
      </div>
    </details>
  </div>`;

  const columns = root.querySelectorAll(".controls-col");
  columns[0].append(sequenceForm);
  columns[1].append(toleranceForm);

  Object.defineProperty(root, "value", {
    get: () => ({...sequenceForm.value, ...toleranceForm.value})
  });

  return root;
}
```

```{ojs}
html`<div>
  <p class="cons-message">${consConclusion}</p>
  <p class="cons-prompt"><strong>Compare:</strong> increase ${tex`n`} under each estimator sequence. Only consistency requires the probability outside <em>every fixed</em> ${tex`\varepsilon`}-band to approach zero.</p>
</div>`
```
